Items.Check: The working model name has 002 after ABC.
Items.Example: PRJ1-070-00-ABC-002-STR-3DM-0010.rvt (change 070 to your building code). Wrong: PRJ1-070-00-ABC-STR-3DM-0010.rvt
Items.From: Client BIM-02 (BLDG-01), BIM-03 (BLDG-02); BIM lead's mail 15-Oct

Items.Check: The submitted copy adds _S03_R00 the first time, then _S03_R01, _S03_R02 for each resubmission.
Items.Example:
First submission: PRJ1-070-00-ABC-002-STR-3DM-0010_S03_R00.rvt
After Client comments: PRJ1-070-00-ABC-002-STR-3DM-0010_S03_R01.rvt

Items.Check: Doc type is right: 3DM for the 3D model, 2DM for the documentation model (the Revit file that holds the sheets), DWG for drawings.
Items.Example:
3D model: PRJ1-070-00-ABC-002-STR-3DM-0010.rvt
Revit file with the sheets (documentation model, if it exists): PRJ1-070-00-ABC-002-STR-2DM-0001.rvt
Drawing: PRJ1-070-00-ABC-002-STR-DWG-0001.pdf
Items.Waiting: Client uses 2DM for sheet numbers, waiting for the BIM lead's reply on mail

Items.Check: The model number comes from the latest MIDP.
Items.Example: Check the number against the MIDP list before you name the file

Items.Check: NWC and IFC files have exactly the same name as the model.
Items.Example:
PRJ1-070-00-ABC-002-STR-3DM-0010_S03_R00.rvt
PRJ1-070-00-ABC-002-STR-3DM-0010_S03_R00.nwc
PRJ1-070-00-ABC-002-STR-3DM-0010_S03_R00.ifc
(only the extension changes)

Items.Check: Level field: a model that covers many levels uses 00 (the BIM lead's rule).
Items.Example:
Use: PRJ1-070-00-ABC-002-STR-3DM-0010_S03_R00.rvt
Client asked for MM instead: PRJ1-070-MM-ABC-002-STR-3DM-0010_S03_R00.rvt (do not use until BIM lead confirms)
Items.From: BIM lead 15-Oct; R04 register (00 = No level / Wide); Client BIM-02 (BLDG-01), BIM-03 (BLDG-02)

Items.Check: File size is 300 MB or less after purge.
Items.Example: Check the size of the e-Transmit output, not the central model

Items.Check: The URS is linked on Z_Link_URS by Shared Coordinates. Grids and levels are copy-monitored from the URS.
Items.Example:
Collaborate > Copy/Monitor > Select Link > URS. Not from the ARC model.
Then link ARC By Shared Coordinates: its grids must sit on yours.
Items.From: Client BIM-14, BIM-09 (D), BIM-12 (BLDG-01); BIM lead QA/QC #17

Items.Check: Grids are in the model and visible in plans.
Items.Example: Client rejected BLDG-01 because the STR file had no grids

Items.Check: Unused levels are deleted. The rest follow the BIM standard level names.
Items.Example: BLDG 7 LVL 01-TOC, BLDG 7 LVL B01-FFL

Items.Check: Every element is on its the BIM standard workset. Nothing but levels and grids on 'Shared Levels and Grids'. Nothing on Workset1. All link worksets exist (STR: all 7 are mandatory).
Items.Example:
STR: raft, pile caps, columns, slabs on ST_Concrete; piles on ST_Enabling.
Link worksets: Z_Link_URS, Z_Link_CAD, Z_Link_AR, Z_Link_EL, Z_Link_ME, Z_Link_SC, Z_Link_SS
Items.From: Client BIM-05 (BLDG-01), BIM-05 (BLDG-02); same fault on BLDG-03 (BIM lead 15-Oct); the BIM standard §2.4 Table 9; group leader 19-Oct

Items.Check: No new worksets unless the BIM Managers agreed them first.
Items.Example: Wrong: MH_Ducting (use MH_HVAC), LC_Design (use EL_LC)

Items.Check: Scope boxes are copied from the URS and keep the same name as in the URS.
Items.Example:
BLDG-01-1101
BLDG = fixed text
07 = building number (08 for BLDG-02, 15 for CUP)
1101 = the number in the agreed cutsheets
Wrong: 'Scope Box 1', 'BLDG7-1101', 'B07-1101'

Items.Check: Every element has the right Revit category. No Generic Models left.
Items.Example: Trench or pit = Structural Foundation, not Generic Model
Items.From: Client BIM-07, BIM-01.4 (BLDG-01); BIM lead QA/QC #5

Items.Check: Family and type names follow the standard.
Items.Example: FN_SC_40MPa_Raft_600. Wrong: 'Foundation Slab 1', '600mm'
Items.Waiting: CamelCase or UPPERCASE (BIM lead, BIM team)

Items.Check: Elements use the proper family type, not a free shape.
Items.Example: Raft = Structural Foundation Slab; footing and pile cap = loadable Structural Foundation family

Items.Check: Columns are modelled level by level. Only a column through a double-height space with no slab stays continuous (list these).
Items.Example: Base: BLDG 7 LVL B01-TOC, Top: BLDG 7 LVL 00-TOC

Items.Check: No duplicate, overlapping or badly joined elements.
Items.Example: Two raft pieces overlapping at a thickening: join or cut so concrete is not counted twice

Items.Check: No floating elements.
Items.Example: A basement column with no foundation under it

Items.Check: At a building edge, each element is in the right building model. A column and the raft under it are in the same model.
Items.Example: BLDG-01/08 joint: columns were in one model, their raft in the other

Items.Check: Nothing is missing compared with the latest ARC model and the design.
Items.Example: Steel beams and composite deck at L04 / roof; roof truss

Items.Check: Other trades' elements are removed from your model.
Items.Example: No ARC walls or MEP pipes inside the STR model

Items.Check: No imported CAD. Typical details are drawn in Revit.
Items.Example: Manage > Imports: count = 0 (or CAD inside one dedicated family)

Items.Check: Model Groups are kept to a minimum.
Items.Example: Ungroup groups used only once

Items.Check: Classification code (UniFormat) is filled on every element.
Items.Example: Raft A1020.60, pile cap A1020.70, floor slab B1010.20 (the standard)

Items.Check: Project parameters follow the naming rule. Parameters from other firms or old projects are deleted. Temporary design-stage parameters are marked.
Items.Example: Delete 'WSP Design Parameters'. Manage > Project Parameters

Items.Check: IFC entity and predefined type are set (by type or by instance).
Items.Example: Pile cap: IfcFooting / PILE_CAP

Items.Check: Warnings are fixed. Any left are listed with a reason in the Health Check report.
Items.Example: Start with 'identical instances' and join warnings

Items.Check: Landing page is LandingPage.rfa for this project and this building (not copied from another job), all red fields are filled, and it opens as the Starting View.
Items.Example:
Path: P:\S26103-0100D\0-CMN\Shared\Titleblock\Latest\LandingPage.rfa
Fill: 3D shot, key plan, building name and code, file name, stage, discipline, WIP or Submission, revision R00 + date, group leader, coordinator.
BLDG-01 was rejected because its landing page was from another project.
Items.From: Client BIM-04 (D, BLDG-01), BIM-02 (BLDG-02); BIM lead 11-Oct §9

Items.Check: All sheets use the title block PRJ1-000-00-ABC-DES-TMP-0000-C.rfa.
Items.Example: Path: P:\S26103-0100D\0-CMN\Shared\Titleblock\Latest\PRJ1-000-00-ABC-DES-TMP-0000-C.rfa

Items.Check: The model name shown in the title block is the same as the actual model file name.
Items.Example: Title block says PRJ1-080-00-ABC-002-STR-3DM-0010_S03_R00 = file name

Items.Check: Drawings use an approved scale.
Items.Example: 1:300 was rejected on BLDG-02. Use 1:100, 1:200 etc.

Items.Check: Every sheet is made from model views. No sheet is a CAD drawing.
Items.Example: Keep a sheet list showing the views on each sheet as proof
Items.From: Client BIM-08 (D, BLDG-01), BIM-07.4 (BLDG-02); BIM lead QA/QC #12

Items.Check: No detail lines or filled regions standing in for real elements.
Items.Example: A beam must be a modelled beam, not two detail lines

Items.Check: The set has a List of Drawings sheet and a General Notes sheet.
Items.Example: Sheet list schedule placed on a sheet

Items.Check: The drawing list has everything the stage needs, and the drawings it relies on are included.
Items.Example: Foundation package: GA, sections, loading plan, general notes, plus the ARC basement GAs it is based on

Items.Check: Every type or thickness has its own hatch, shown in the legend. Nothing left blank.
Items.Example: Give every thickness its own hatch. Do not leave any thickness blank: when a new thickness is added later, no one remembers to give it a hatch, so it shows blank by mistake.

Items.Check: Browser organisation, view templates and filters are the same for every team modelling this trade on PRJ1, whichever office they are in.
Items.Example: Compare with the trade's standard template

Items.Check: Every view is in a folder (discipline / sub-discipline). No '???'. Views are named clearly.
Items.Example: Project Browser shows no '???' group

Items.Check: Each view has the view template and filters for its purpose. Not every view on the Coordination template.
Items.Example: Plan views on the plan template, sections on the section template, the 3D Navisworks view on its own template

Items.Check: Unused views are deleted.
Items.Example: Keep only views on sheets + the 3D Navisworks Export view

Items.Check: Schedules you use stay in the submitted model.
Items.Example: Foundation schedule by type and volume
Items.Waiting: tick Schedules in e-Transmit or put them on sheets

Items.Check: Self-check (SDC): no clashes inside your own trade and its sub-systems.
Items.Example: STR beams vs STR columns; ducts vs pipes inside MEP

Items.Check: Your clash tests in the federated model are run and your clashes are fixed. In Trade-1_Vs_Trade-2, Trade 1 fixes.
Items.Example: MP pipes vs SC foundations is P1 (25 mm clearance)
Items.From: Client BIM-15, STR-05 (D) (BLDG-01); BIM lead 15-Oct; the drawing standard

Items.Check: Model Checker template is run until the score is 90% or more. Keep the score in the QA/QC record.
Items.Example: 0-CMN\Shared\Library\RVT\Model Checker Templates. Note any check that fights STD names

Items.Check: The checklist is signed by the group leader and the BIM coordinator. The Model Health Check report goes in the package.
Items.Example: Health Check report: PRJ1-070-00-ABC-002-STR-RPT-0001_S03_R00.pdf, signed

Items.Check: A '3D Navisworks Export' view with the trade view template: your own elements only, no levels, grids or rooms, wireframe.
Items.Example: Hide links, rooms, levels, grids in that view

Items.Check: NWC is exported from the central model (synced), not a local copy.
Items.Example: Wrong: the NWC source name ends with a user name, e.g. ..._username.rvt

Items.Check: NWC settings: shared coordinates, current view, divide into levels, convert element IDs, parameters All, element and type properties.
Items.Example: Linked files and linked CAD not converted

Items.Check: IFC: Revit IFC 4x3 with the 'MOD IFC Export Setup', shared coordinates (UTM84-38N). Civil 3D: IFC4, Coordination View 2.0.
Items.Example: Only visible elements; linked files not exported

Items.Check: NWC is published on Monday, and published again after fixes before submission.
Items.Example: Save to the Shared folder, same name as the model

Items.Check: Submit detached, with all links unloaded, your own model only. No ARC, URS or other trade models in your ZIP.
Items.Example: Other trades' models come from their own submittals; Client sees all trades in the federated NWD
Items.From: Client BIM-01.3, BIM-06.3 (BLDG-01); BIM lead QA/QC #11; group leader and BIM lead 19-Oct

Items.Check: e-Transmit settings: purge unused; include CAD links and image files; keep views on sheets + the 3D Navisworks view.
Items.Example: Linked Revit models: unticked

Items.Check: Sheets that show another trade as background are handled as agreed.
Items.Example: With links unloaded, an ARC background on an STR sheet will be blank

Items.Check: Civil 3D only: one ZIP per model, with fonts, textures, data-link and photometric files.
Items.Example: Mark NA for Revit models

Items.Check: Package has everything the stage needs: native + IFC + NWC; drawings DWG + PDF; BOQ (XLSX + PDF) if needed; reports PDF.
Items.Example: Federated NWD + clash report come from the BIM team, check they are in the same transmittal

Items.Check: Open the package from a clean folder: it opens on the landing page, worksets and views look right.
Items.Example: Copy the ZIP to your desktop, unzip, open
